limitations: This is an independent provisional browser evaluation of the attached screenshots, labeled still-frame sequences and supplied runtime account; no additional files, source, previous ratings or live application were inspected.

Corresponding normal, 200%, transition and repeated captures are grouped under their screen/state entries; distinct error, empty, selected, expanded and populated states are separated where their task changes.
A is the mean of hierarchy, typography and surfaces; F is the mean of clarity, feedback and accessibility; overall is 0.4A + 0.6F, excluding genuinely inapplicable null dimensions.

The A>=9 and F>=9 threshold is not met for every screen or component: repeated browser-visible weaknesses remain in enlarged typography, material integration, disclosure density and opening continuity.
No hard-gate failure is established by the supplied evidence; content outside a captured viewport is not treated as unreachable where supplied scrolling and reachability checks cover it.
Runtime claims are supplied evidence rather than independently reproduced results; screenshots alone do not establish interaction, persistence, accessible semantics or predictive quality.
Physical iPhone/VoiceOver, native keyboard, haptics, tilt, native sharing, notifications and native performance remain deferred without score deductions solely for that boundary.
Billing is simulated, navigator.share is mocked and connected Circles behavior is unavailable; no successful real purchase, native share or connected social task is certified.
Synthetic passages and labeled layout fixtures are not treated as production-copy or model-quality failures; their visible density still informs layout assessment.
Filmstrips establish sampled visual states, not frame rate or continuous motion quality; browser performance and reduced-motion credit rely on the separate supplied runtime measurements.
The painted orb, stand, table and foreground bottles provide visible depth cues, but the attachments do not independently establish the implementation or motion of every proposed painted layer.
topFixes: Remove the opening sequence’s near-invisible orb frame and preserve continuous visual presence through forecast arrival.
Replace enlarged forecast display capitals with the more readable body treatment already used in check-in, keeping all text centered.
Strengthen parchment-choice keyboard focus so it is as unmistakable as the demonstrated Close, Back and wood-button outlines.
Reduce dense centered explanation and disclosure blocks through shorter passage groups, clearer section hierarchy and restrained dividers.
Refine room crossfades, table/background focus boundaries and parchment contact lighting to reduce double-room and pasted-layer effects.
Compact enlarged check-in, plans and profile layouts so decisions, status and their actions remain visually close.
